description: This walk or cycle follows the Speyside Way from Kingussie to Newtonmore. The surfaced roadside trail takes you through some lovely countryside between the two settlements. It runs for about 3 miles along a flat trail with some excellent views of the surrounding Cairngorms mountains. You can continue your walking on the circular Wildcat Trail in Newtonmore .
